Metadata.title: Rehla — Your companion on the path of light
Metadata.description: An AI-powered platform that accompanies new Muslims from the moment they declare the Shahada to confident practice and belonging, in their own language and grounded in approved sources.

Home.eyebrow: For new Muslims, after the Shahada
Home.title: Rehla
Home.tagline: Your companion on the path of light
Home.intro: Rehla is an AI-powered platform that accompanies new Muslims from the moment they declare the Shahada to confident practice and belonging, in their own language and grounded in approved sources.

why.title: Why Rehla
why.body: Right after the Shahada, a new Muslim faces practical questions that cannot wait: how to purify and pray, how to behave in a mosque for the first time, what the Arabic texts around them mean, and who to turn to when stuck. Human follow-up alone cannot be present in their every day.

stations.title: Stations of the journey
stations.description: What the journey offers, one station at a time.
stations.label: Station {number}

learn.name: Khutuwat · Steps
learn.body: A graded learning path: lessons, short quizzes, and an explanation for every mistake.

rafiq.name: Ask Rafiq
rafiq.body: Answers cited to their sources, with abstention and referral when needed.

mawqif.name: Mawqif · Situations
mawqif.body: Practise everyday situations interactively, with evaluation and correction.

adasa.name: Adasa · Lens
adasa.body: Photograph the Arabic text around you and have it explained in your language.

community.name: Rehla Community
community.body: An opt-in forum with verified da’wah guides, and a directory of nearby mosques and centers.

aqim.name: Aqim
aqim.body: A camera-based practice prayer that ends with a report on your performance.

attribution.title: Every statement is sourced
attribution.body: Every religious statement is shown with its source; nothing is attributed to a reference that does not contain it.

referral.title: Abstention and referral
referral.body: When no reference is found, or for personal and disputed matters, Rafiq abstains and refers you to a qualified person. The system does not issue fatwas.

verbatim.title: Sacred text is never generated
verbatim.body: Quran verses and hadiths are displayed verbatim from their approved sources.

transparency.title: Transparency
transparency.body: Rafiq discloses that it is an AI tool, not a human specialist.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: You state your own stage; the system does not infer any religious or sensitive attribute about you.

closing.title: The road is ahead of you
closing.body: Start at the first station, at your own pace.

AiNotice.label: About Rafiq
AiNotice.title: Rafiq is an AI tool.
AiNotice.body: It is not a human scholar. It answers from approved sources and cites them, and it does not issue fatwas. For personal matters, consult a qualified scholar.

Human.title: Talk to a human
Human.description: People and centres you can turn to with your own questions.
Human.whyHuman: Rafiq is an AI tool. It explains what the lessons say, but it does not give rulings on anyone's personal situation. For your own case, speak with a qualified person.
Human.emptyBody: We list a centre here only after its contact details have been checked against its official source, so this list is still empty.
Human.emptyMeanwhile: Until then, the people at a mosque or Islamic centre near you are a good place to start.
Human.privacy: Rehla shares nothing about you with these centres. Whether and how you contact them is entirely your choice.
